params.name: Id
params.description: Filter by one or more specific partner IDs, provided as a comma-separated list.

params.name: CampaignId
params.description: Filter to list only partners joined to the specified campaign (program).

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter by partners whose DateLastUpdated occurs after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter by partners whose DateLastUpdated occurs before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: State
params.description: Filter by the state of the partner account.

params.name: RelationshipState
params.description:
Filter by the partner's current relationship with your program. Possible values:
- `ACTIVE` — The partner has an active relationship with you.
- `INACTIVE` — The partner doesn't have a contractual relationship with you.

items.docs: Returns a list of all your partners, sorted by creation date. The list can be filtered by various parameters such as Campaign, Group, Country, and State.
Creates a new direct partner account, which automatically joins your program with a specified active contract.

params.name: PartnerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the partner.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing partner by their unique ID.

params.name: PartnerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the partner to update.

items.docs: Updates the custom `MPValue{i}` fields for a specified partner. These values can be used in tracking links.
